_readme: This file is only a TEMPLATE and it is uploaded to GitHub. Copy it to appsettings.Local.json (git ignores that copy) and put your real passwords in the COPY, never in this file.

Email._readme: Optional. Fill it in so the notifications are also sent to the email address a person adds in Settings. For Gmail: Host smtp.gmail.com, Port 587, User and From your Gmail address, and an APP PASSWORD (Google Account > Security > App passwords) as Password.
